name: Golden Carrot Orange Smoothie with Turmeric & Ginger
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the oranges; remove the white pith, and cut into chunks. Add to blender.
Peel the carrots and ginger, and cut into chunks. Add to blender.
Add mango, almond milk, cashews, turmeric, and 4 ice cubes.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses and enjoy!
author: Mealime
